statement: For n≥3, the largest complex planar realization number among n-vertex Laman graphs obeys M2(n)≥2·2^((n−3) mod 15)·976908^floor((n−3)/15). The construction glues copies of an eighteen-vertex graph with exactly 1,953,816 realizations along a triangle; its exponential growth base is 976908^(1/15)≈2.50798. Counts identify translations and rotations, retaining reflected realizations.

answer.text: M2(n)≥2·2^((n−3) mod 15)·976908^floor((n−3)/15), with growth base approximately 2.50798.
